Ruins of Detlas#001.src: You read an entry in the worn journal...
Ruins of Detlas#001.dst: 你读了这本破旧日记里的一篇记录……

Ruins of Detlas#002.src: A stranger came into town today all the way from {p}. {p} of all places! What do the folk there want with us in this small town?
Ruins of Detlas#002.dst: 今天镇上来了个陌生人，大老远从 {p} 来的。偏偏是 {p}！那里的人找我们这种小镇要干什么？

Ruins of Detlas#003.src: It's nothing but farmland for as far as the eye can see around here. I want some excitement! I want to go to {p} and see the castle there!
Ruins of Detlas#003.dst: 这一带放眼望去全是农田。我想要点刺激！我想去 {p} 看看那里的城堡！

Ruins of Detlas#004.src: Then again, the roads are more dangerous now than they ever have been. If rumors are to be trusted, you can't step three feet out of town without running into an undead

Ruins of Detlas#005.src: Who knows, maybe this'll all blow over soon...
Ruins of Detlas#005.dst: 谁知道呢，说不定这一切很快就会过去……

Ruins of Detlas#006.src: That trader from {p} was saying some disturbing things the other day.

Ruins of Detlas#007.src: He mentioned that the undead attacks are growing more frequent all over Wynn. Even {p} is straining under the pressure.

Ruins of Detlas#008.src: {p} has managed to avoid the worst of the scourge. But how much longer will our luck last?

Ruins of Detlas#009.src: It's been unusually quiet these past few days. I don't like it. Even for a small town such as {p}, there is such a thing as being too quiet.

Ruins of Detlas#010.src: I fear the rumors of the increasing undead roaming the lands. What's worse, there are other rumors saying that they are being led by a human.

Ruins of Detlas#011.src: What madman would turn against their own kind in favor of... those things?

Ruins of Detlas#012.src: I just hope I can keep my people safe. Wait, I fear something approaches..

Ruins of Detlas#013.src: The book is torn in half. The rest of the entry must be somewhere nearby...

Ruins of Detlas#014.src: The pages are torn and are black with soot on the edges. You read the rest of the entry...

Ruins of Detlas#015.src: This may be my final entry. The human leading the horde is no human. He is tainted. Broken. Controlled.

Ruins of Detlas#016.src: Fire spreads from his hands like magic.. If only we had such power. Someone has to stop this. Alas, it can not be me. He is here.

Ruins of Detlas#017.src: I was talking to Mary the other day. She said some of the survivors are planning to make the trip to {p} or {p}.

Ruins of Detlas#018.src: She asked me if we should go with them. I told her we we're staying here. The road to {p} is too dangerous, and {p} is too far away.

Ruins of Detlas#019.src: But as the night draws near, I'm not sure about my decision...

Ruins of Detlas#020.src: This journal is opened to an entry dated {~} AP. You begin to read it...

Ruins of Detlas#021.src: There aren't that many left in this town. If this place can even be called a town.

Ruins of Detlas#022.src: There's me, Hank, Mary, their kids, the Mayor who's crazy now, Andy, Steve, and Judy and her kids.

Ruins of Detlas#023.src: We only have enough for about a day or so. We have no choice: we need to leave for a fortress.

Ruins of Detlas#024.src: Andy, Steve, and I will lead. The road to {p} is difficult. If you read this, I hope {p} still stands.
